text: Install, check or remove the Aidus Code Scripts-menu folder in a FontLab user folder. Ported from aidus-code's install.py (archived in original/install.py). The old installer symlinked the whole plugin into FontLab's Scripts folder, replaced whatever was there, and ran uv sync for the brain. Here the host package is installed with uv pip (README), and this module only manages <user folder>/Scripts/Aidus Code : the same three thin menu scripts as the repository's Aidus Code/ folder plus a manifest ( .fontlab-aidus-code-install , format 1) holding the sha256 of every file it wrote. Ownership is per file: unknown entries are kept, a modified, foreign or symlinked entry stops an install before anything changes, and uninstall removes only unmodified owned files and the folder only when it is then empty. A folder without a valid manifest, including the workspace orchestrator's symlink, is never touched. Run on the host, not inside FontLab: fontlab-aidus-install {install,check,uninstall} .
